reason: That's EUR 5,000 committed before I know if I get a single meeting, and you tell me straight out nothing is guaranteed and the first meeting might take two months. I paid an agency before and got zero meetings, so without a cost per meeting and a payback figure I'm not signing.
objection: I've heard 'we research your accounts and write in the local language' before and still got nothing. No guarantee plus a 3-month lock-in means all the risk sits with me.
would_change_my_mind: A month-one pilot with no 3-month minimum, or part of the fee tied to qualified meetings, plus two references from manufacturers or exporters my size who can show me their cost per meeting.
